item: A script looks for each statistics agency's news page and proposes it for a person to confirm
summary: 0.6 gate row A (Q1147) owes a news_url per agency, set only once someone fetched the page and confirmed it; nothing could look, so directory_progress read 0 confirmed. scripts/stat_news_check.py reads each agency's home page and at most three same-site links (declared feeds first, then links holding a news word in one of the twelve languages) through make_fetcher (EthicalFetcher: robots fail-closed, honest UA or the protected-mode proxy, SSRF guards), every redirect held to the agency's registrable domain. A feed with at least 3 entries or a page with at least 3 distinct written dates is PROPOSED, with the shape measured beside it and a caveat that a shape is not a confirmation. It refuses without --online (the run's consent) after naming the hosts, keeps a refusal as its class and a fixed word (never the library's text), never writes agencies.py, and writes one JSON report of at most 200 KB.
